Overall, it's reliable, affordable, and has kept my routine simple and effective through my 30s.

avis.texte: Great, gentle everyday scrub! Very light scent and easy to use! Great size bottle and amount for the price. My husband and I use it everyday and we both have sensitive skin!

avis.titre: My favorite OTC face wash, dermatologist approved!
avis.texte: Effective for removing makeup, fun texture to use while washing your face. Not too abrasive, lightly scented. Easy to open packaging for while in the shower. Great value for the price, it lasts a really long time.
I've been using this for awhile and like how it gently cleans my skin. Also there isn't a strong scent, which is a plus for me. Since it's in a squeeze bottle it's easy to use.

avis.titre: Good but not sure for daily use
avis.texte: I really like this product. It scrubs nicely and leaves my face feeling well exfoliated. It does not have an overly abrasive scrub and smells fresh and clean. Good value but I have found that if used daily it does tend to irritate my skin some.

Cetaphil has a long-standing reputation for its quality and this product upholds that reputation. It is nice and smooth on your face, it has a good smell, and keeps my skin feeling moisturized and fresh!

Where has this been for the past 25 years of my life?!? My skin is very temperamental, being both combination and super sensitive. No other product that I have tried fixed my acne, if anything they've made it worse. I couldn't be happier with this product, will be using this from now on.

As an Advanced Esthetician student, I've been searching for gentle scrubs for sensitive skin and this product is it! It's not rough on the skin at all, and I'm able to see a difference with my skin after using this for the last 4 months. Definitely a must if you have combination skin.

I started using this product about a month ago and it had caused so many problems with my skin! The first time I used it, it started burning my skin I couldn't get it off fast enough! I tried using it several more times after to give it more of a chance and every time it got worse. I was breaking out and experiencing a lot of dryness and patchiness. However after using it this last time I am throwing this product out. I now have a horrible red rash all over my face on top of the acne and dry patches! Nothing I do is calming it down or making it go away! Everything that I try just makes my skin burn! I am so disappointed in this product especially since it is made by Cetaphil! I have never had such a bad reaction to ANY face products the way I have with this. I will not be recommending this product to anyone! Cetaphil really needs to re evaluate this product being as tho there are SO MANY bad reviews on this product claiming the same experience I am having!!!
This gel cleanses the skin well. I really like the soft cleaning particles. The skin does not dry out after washing with the gel. The aroma is light and pleasant.
This brand of Cetaphil helped me a lot with my rough, and Problem skin. It was gritty but not too rough, the scent wasn't bad. I use it almost daily.

I love this for exactly what it says it does, it gently exfoliates and deeply cleanses the skin. I use it about twice or sometimes three times a week. After that, even though it's not an abrasive scrub, I can definitely tell a difference in how my Skincare applies after that. ￼
Was excited because it would be a gentle scrub unaware of how strongly it smells of perfumes. Would prefer unscented.

I wish if I could have given this Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub more than five stars. My dermatologist had given me a few samples of this scrub and i instantly fell in love with it. I love how the micro fine particles feel when i use it to exfoliate my face. It leave my face feeling soft, smooth and bright looking. This gentle scrub definitely removes dirt, oil and dead skin from my face also it has skin conditioners and vitamin that help leave my face soft and smooth. I definitely recommend this Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub.

avis.titre: Super fine texture & great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Big fan of the gentle exfoliation in this product! The texture is great and the beads are super fine so it's not abrasive like other brands. Nice light scent and does not dry out my sensitive combination skin. Love cetaphil & especially the ingredients. Exclusively started using this skin care brand (and ceravae).

avis.titre: It soothes the skin very well
avis.texte: The scent is very delightful, the packaging is great, the texture is very soothing, the ingredients used in this product is for everyone and it is also dermatologist recommended

avis.titre: First cleanser that works on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have struggled with a skin condition for years. I cannot tell you the number of products I have tried with no success. This scrub keeps my pores clear with no irritation or breakouts. I do use a very light weight, waterbased gel mortise after using it. I have had outbreaks and peeling caused by demodex bemy in t-zone. I also have rosacea. Alright my skin flecks slightly dry, I cannot use any cream based products - even if they are oil free. This product is helping my skin to clear and heal. So thankful for it. I use it twice a day.
This is the best exfoliator I've tried! So many are either sand paper or so fine that it doesn't do anything. This is a lovely middle ground between the two. And the price point is great.

As someone with sensitive skin, I've always been cautious about trying new facial scrubs. However, Cetaphil's Extra Gentle Daily Scrub exceeded my expectations. Its mild exfoliation left my skin feeling refreshed without any irritation. Plus, it's fragrance-free, which is perfect for those with sensitive noses. Overall, it's become a staple in my skincare routine for its gentle yet effective cleansing.

I have combination skin and this cleanser is gentle enough to use every day. I like the light texture and its fine granules. It's more of a cleanser, however it gives that extra bit of oomf to get my skin clean without drying it out. It leaves my skin feeling clean without a residue.

I use this in the shower to really try and clean my skin and give it that soft feeling. I definitely think it cleans better than normal liquid cleanser, however, I wish the beads were a tiny bit bigger! But, otherwise, I would buy again

I love this gentle exfoliator! My skin needs additional help to remove dry patches a few times a week, but I have to be careful because many can be quite abrasive and aggravate my face. This one, however, is gritty enough to slough off the dead skin without doing so.
